subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should OpenClaw raise the unset QMD embed timeout default globally from 120s to 600s, or solve local GGUF timeouts with a narrower strategy?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes existing users' default subprocess runtime and lock-wait behavior; automation cannot decide that product/upgrade tradeoff without maintainer intent and real runtime proof or an explicit override.

options.title: Require proof before global default
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted real QMD/GGUF logs or a linked artifact show the unset 600s default completing successfully and maintainers accept the longer default.

options.title: Narrow the timeout strategy
options.body: Ask for a selective local-GGUF or warning/docs-only path that avoids changing every unset QMD install's timeout and lock budgets.

options.title: Accept the broad default knowingly
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept longer QMD embed and lock waits for all unset configs despite the missing live QMD proof.

recommendation.title: Require proof before global default
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted real QMD/GGUF logs or a linked artifact show the unset 600s default completing successfully and maintainers accept the longer default.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned on the PR and recently changed the same QMD config/default surfaces.
